name: deco-cli
stderr:
Usage: deco-cli [options] [command]

CLI for managing decocms.com apps & projects

Options:
  -V, --version                         output the version number
  -t, --token <token>                   Authentication token to use for API
                                        requests
  -l, --local                           Deploy the app locally (Needs
                                        admin.decocms.com running at
                                        http://localhost:3001)
  -h, --help                            display help for command

Commands:
  login                                 Log in to admin.decocms.com and
                                        retrieve tokens for CLI usage.
  logout                                Log out of admin.decocms.com and remove
                                        local session data.
  whoami                                Print info about the current session.
  hosting                               Manage hosting apps in a workspace.
  deploy [options] [cwd]                Deploy the current directory into the
                                        current workspace.
  promote [options]                     Promote a deployment to an existing
                                        route pattern.
  dev [options]                         Start a development server.
  configure|config                      Save configuration options for the
                                        current directory.
  add [options] [app-name]              Add integrations from the registry to
                                        the current project.
  call-tool [options] <tool>            Call a tool on an integration using MCP
                                        protocol.
  upgrade                               Upgrade the deco CLI to the latest
                                        version.
  update [options]                      Update Deco dependencies to their
                                        latest versions.
  link [options]                        Link the project to be accessed through
                                        a remote domain.
  gen [options]                         Generate the environment that will be
                                        used to run the app.
  create [project-name]                 Create a new project from a template.
  deconfig                              Manage deconfig filesystem operations.
  project                               Manage MCP project import/export.
  registry                              Manage apps in the registry.
  completion [options] <type>           Generate shell completions (internal
                                        command)
  install-completion [options] [shell]  Install shell completion scripts
  help [command]                        display help for command

Runtime: node
